## What's Changed
* Migrate typechecking to ty by @kracekumar in https://github.com/dbcli/litecli/pull/242
* Add sqlean stubs by @kracekumar in https://github.com/dbcli/litecli/pull/243
* Make the llm library optional by @amjith in https://github.com/dbcli/litecli/pull/246


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/litecli/compare/v1.17.0...v1.17.1
